estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough (PowerPyx roadmap)
online_note: Online trophies: 0 of 55. Every trophy is offline single-player (PowerPyx), so the roadmap has no online stage — Stage 4 is duo free-roam and misc cleanup instead.

stages.summary: Play the five-chapter campaign in order. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one permanent save before the final mission — there is no mission replay. Meditate at Jason's house during Chapter 1 (the one missable), scan vehicles and animals as you travel, and clear each side-character strand (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as it opens.
stages.title: Story first — chapters, missions & strand finales

stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work its lines: they are lenient (70 of 80 challenges, partial collectibles) except robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, which need everything. Sweep Leonida region by region for the 52 areas, 18 meditation spots, card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100+ vehicles, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations in the same trips.
stages.title: 100% checklist & the collectible sweep

stages.summary: Gold all 42 shooting range challenges, win a drone race at all 14 locations, win 20 different races, complete 250 stunts and 50 challenges, rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck, hit one illegal operation per gang (9), beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, bowl at Kolt & Associates' alley and complete Bret's unique-animal hunt.
stages.title: Activities, challenges & robbery craft

stages.summary: Everything left is a one-off: the partner trophies (lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back), the choice counter, the fail-then-succeed and partnership hidden trophies — all save-sensitive because there is no mission replay — plus Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhino, the stealth jewelry robbery, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, the strange event, the melee drive-by, laundering $250,000 and spending $100,000. Finish the 8 stranger strands here for Strangers & Freaks.
stages.title: Duo free-roam, choices & misc cleanup

stages.summary: When the 54th trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! unlocks on its own. Check the tracker header: 55/55, with 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze.
stages.title: Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
